This ensures the '@' character exists and is not the last character. For the first call `ourUserID.substring(ourUserID.indexOf("@") + 1)`, beginIndex is at least 1 and at most `length()-1`, so it is non-negative and less than or equal to the string length, avoiding `IndexOutOfBoundsException`. For the second call `ourUserID.substring(0, ourUserID.indexOf("@"))`, beginIndex is 0 (non-negative), endIndex is between 0 and `length()-2` (non-negative and ≤ length), and beginIndex ≤ endIndex, so all conditions for `IndexOutOfBoundsException` are avoided.
